label: non-small cell lung carcinoma
notes: The cohort's disease. 35 patients; histology subtypes are not in the GEO metadata, so nothing narrower than NSCLC is assertable here.

label: lung adenocarcinoma
notes: P5-T4's EXTERNAL cohort only (TCGA-LUAD via UCSC Xena), never this study. Recorded separately because the two cohorts are not interchangeable: ADR 0027 §5 bounds the comparison structurally, and LUAD is narrower than the NSCLC above.

label: spatial transcriptomics
notes: NanoString GeoMx DSP Whole Transcriptome Atlas. The term is the closest defensible one: this assay profiles pathologist-placed regions and carries NO coordinates, so it is spatial in the sense of "region resolved", never spot-gridded.

label: RNA-Seq
notes: The WTA readout is sequencing of released oligo barcodes, counted per AOI. Recorded because "spatial transcriptomics" alone does not say how the signal was measured.

label: Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded
notes: Archival FFPE sections; the preservation the assay was designed for.

label: lymph node
notes: 13 AOIs (mLN), out of scope for the core lung-vs-brain comparison.

label: neoplastic cell
notes: 70 AOIs (L, LB, mLN). The PanCK-POSITIVE segment — the only compartment here that was actually collected on an antibody mask, and still an enrichment rather than a sorted population.

label: leukocyte
notes: 23 AOIs (TIME-L 15, TIME-B 8). PanCK-negative segment of an ROI sited in a CD45-rich region. NOT a CD45-sorted population, and `TIME-B` n = 8 is the binding constraint on the project.

label: astrocyte
notes: 20 AOIs (TBME). PanCK-negative segment of an ROI sited in GFAP-rich tumour-adjacent brain. NOT a GFAP-sorted population.

label: brain
notes: 7 AOIs (BC). The ONLY compartment mapped to a tissue rather than a cell type, and deliberately: nothing was sorted, no tumour is present, and there is no cell population this control is enriched for. An honest absence beats a plausible CL term.

label: Primary Neoplasm
notes: The `L` and `TIME-L` AOIs — primary lung tumour and its immune compartment.

label: Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Brain
notes: The `LB`, `TBME` and `TIME-B` AOIs. The exact-label term; MONDO:1040026 carries the same label and either would do, and NCIT is recorded because §7.2 names it for disease-context fields.
